verdict.rationale: The evidence shows rule-based automation: smart categorisation explains new transactions from previous descriptions, and Smart Capture matches receipts and bills to transactions. It also shows a bank transactions API. None of this is an agent that reconciles a month end-to-end, flags exceptions or prepares a close for human review. The automation is an adjacent feature and the API is a developer building block, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
